definitions.gloss: crest, coat of arms, emblem, heraldic symbol
definitions.explanation: A symbolic design used to identify a family, organization, or institution. In Japanese contexts, refers to family crests ({家紋|かもん}). In Western contexts, refers to coats of arms and heraldic symbols.

examples.japanese: {王家|おうけ}の{紋章|もんしょう}が{刻|きざ}まれている。
examples.english: The royal coat of arms is engraved on it.

examples.japanese: この{盾|たて}には{騎士|きし}の{家|いえ}の{紋章|もんしょう}が{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: The knight's family crest is depicted on this shield.

examples.japanese: ヨーロッパでは、{紋章|もんしょう}は{家柄|いえがら}や{地位|ちい}を{示|しめ}す{重要|じゅうよう}なシンボルだった。
examples.english: In Europe, coats of arms were important symbols indicating family lineage and status.

notes:
USAGE:
{紋章|もんしょう} can refer to both Japanese {家紋|かもん} (family crests) and Western heraldic designs. In practice, it is more commonly used for Western-style coats of arms and in fantasy/game contexts, while {家紋|かもん} is preferred for traditional Japanese family crests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紋章|もんしょう}{学|がく}: heraldry
- {家|いえ}の{紋章|もんしょう}: family crest
- {王家|おうけ}の{紋章|もんしょう}: royal coat of arms
- {紋章|もんしょう}を{掲|かか}げる: to display a coat of arms
